edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address for transfers in _transfer.
manualswap requires _msgSender() to equal _opAddress.
manualsend requires _msgSender() to equal _opAddress.
blockBots is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
setTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
allowPreTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
setMaxTxnAmount is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
setMaxWalletSize is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
toggleSwap is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
setFee is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender().
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
Timestamp deadline flows into the external router call, making it timestamp dependent.
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when the swap threshold is reached.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after swapping.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard for the transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call to the router before state settles.
sendETHToFee performs a native ETH transfer to _opAddress.
_transferStandard performs sub/add on reflection balances.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_getValues derives reflection values via _getRValues.
_getValues derives token values via _getTValues.
_getRValues performs mul/sub arithmetic on amounts.
_reflectFee performs sub/add on _rTotal and _tFeeTotal.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to allocate team tokens.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to update reflections.
_rOwned is read and written by _transferStandard.
_rTotal is decremented inside _reflectFee.
_opAddress is the recipient of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
uniswapV2Router is used for the swap and approval in swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Pair determines buy/sell direction and swap eligibility in _transfer.
tradingOpen gates transfers inside _transfer.
inSwap guard is checked and set around the swap in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates automatic swapping in _transfer.
bots blacklist is checked for both from and to in _transfer.
preTrader whitelist is checked when trading is not open.
_maxTxAmount caps transfer amount and swap size in _transfer.
_swapTokensAtAmount is the swap trigger threshold in _transfer.
_redisFee is set based on buy/sell direction in _transfer.
_taxFee is set based on buy/sell direction in _transfer.
_taxFee is consumed by _getTValues to compute the team amount.
The external router call can re-enter the transfer path before state finalization.
The ETH transfer to _opAddress can re-enter the contract via receive().
from parameter drives all checks and accounting in _transfer.
to parameter drives direction detection and wallet limits in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated against limits in _transfer.
tokenAmount is swapped via the router in swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount is forwarded to _opAddress in sendETHToFee.
bots_ array is iterated to populate the blacklist in blockBots.
maxTxAmount parameter is written into _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxnAmount.
contractTokenBalance determines swap execution in _transfer.
takeFee flag decides whether fees are removed in _tokenTransfer.
path array is supplied to the router call in swapTokensForEth.
currentRate feeds reflection computations in _getValues.
contractETHBalance gates the fee send in _transfer.
canSwap gates the swap execution in _transfer.
